by: companies, the October package (proposed; the integrator appends it to the ledger)
title: The Companies Office's monthly bulk package, held whole: a zip of CSVs

landmarks: a zip whose members include companies_core_data.csv, companies_director.csv, companies_shareholder.csv and companies_registered_office_address.csv

signals_note: Downloaded by Arthur from the Companies Office's bulk-data folder; pinned by hash in registers/companies/monthly.py PACKAGES. The first: Companies Office Bulk Data October 2026.zip, its CSVs dated 1 October 2026.
notes: Read: companies_core_data, companies_director, companies_shareholder, companies_registered_office_address, and the core data of other incorporated entities, charitable trust boards, public sector entities and retirement villages. Not read: every address column of a shareholder, a director, a statutory supervisor, an operator or premises (a person's address is never held); unincorporated entities (sole traders); and the other files (insolvency, trading names, websites, GST, ABN, industry, public address, address for service). Dates dd/mm/yyyy (core data of companies), as filed elsewhere. The file states no role end date, no role type and no suppression mark.
applies_to: the Companies Office monthly bulk package from October 2026 on
process: Lay the package over the export: an entity by its NZBN, else its register number; a director role on company, names and start; a holding on company, holder, shares and status; a registered office on its body, start and lines. A row the package does not list keeps its files; no end date is written.
gates: Every line is a row or a catch-log line.
The package's line count per file is its rows plus its repeated lines.
The companies live on the last quarter end before the cut, and each month, against the Companies Office's own statistics (check.py).
